d.ko: Guide an ever-growing Line through a multiple of environments, listening carefully to the music. Tap the screen to make a sharp turn, avoiding obstacles and reacting to the World changing before your eyes.
d.en: Guide an ever-growing Line through a multiple of environments, listening carefully to the music. Tap the screen to make a sharp turn, avoiding obstacles and reacting to the World changing before your eyes.
d.zh: 随着音乐引导一条无限延伸的线条通过不同的环境。点一下屏幕以转弯，从而因应眼前不断变化的世界做出相应的反应及避开障碍物。
